title: create-flow <FlowName>.flow.json
description: One Power Automate flow, written by the model and turned into a legacy import package by scripts/build_flow_package.py. triggers and actions are the Logic Apps workflow definition's own triggers and actions; the builder adds every GUID, operationMetadataId, the $connections and $authentication parameters, host.apiId, the authentication input and the connection references. Tenant values are written as named placeholders, {{Name}}, declared under placeholders. Checked by scripts/flow_lint.py.

name.description: ASCII PascalCase. The package is written as <name>_LegacyPackage.zip.

displayName.description: The flow's name in Power Automate, in the user's language. Unique within flow.md.

connectors.description: API names of every connector an action or trigger uses, e.g. shared_office365.

triggers.description: Exactly one trigger, keyed by its name (the button trigger is 'manual').

placeholders.description: Every {{Name}} used in triggers or actions: what it stands for and where to set it after import.
